hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *platform/*.ts) cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/platform" && npx tsc --noEmit || exit 2;; esac
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); if git -C "$root" status --porcelain -- platform | grep -q .; then cd "$root/platform" && npm test || exit 2; fi
